messages:
eval-bot: NIGHTLY EVAL ALERT - run=abc1234, 2024-02-28 06:08 UTC. Failed suites: instruct_qa (p50 ↓ 18%), multi-turn-coherence (regression > threshold), safety-filter (FP rate ↑ 3.6%). Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/run/abc1234  severity: P2.
sasha: assigning owners — maya + oliver on instruct_qa, tony on multi-turn, jordan on safety. please react :eyes: if you can take.
maya: on it. grabbing repro set and failing samples now. will post first triage in ~15m.
oliver: I can pair on quant diffs. quick note: last deploy included int4 kernels + tokenizer tweak. running a quick float vs int4 diff now.
tony: I see a spike in long-context latency on the nightlies around the same time window. pulling KV cache hit/miss logs and batch sizes.
jordan: safety FP increase looks correlated with the new promptset filter changes? will pull examples and classifier scores.
sasha: initial hypothesis: int4 quant rollout + tokenizer change = combo causing quality shift. keep P2 unless user-facing or >10% of a cohort fails, then escalate to P1.
maya: repro notes: failing examples are short Q->A few-shot prompts. int4 outputs are truncating completions mid-sentence. sample below:
```input: "Summarize the email: Hi team, we need to ship by Friday..."
fp16_output: "In summary, we should ship by Friday and..."
int4_output: "In summary, we should"
```
small sample set uploaded: https://redwood.internal/storage/evals/abc1234/artifacts/instruct-samples.json
oliver: ran: `./eval_runner --run abc1234 --suite instruct_qa --compare fp16 int4 --save-diffs` results: 18% p50 drop largely concentrated on 3 prompts with longer few-shot contexts. linking CSV: https://redwood.internal/storage/evals/abc1234/diffs.csv
tony: KV cache glance: 9:58-10:02 UTC saw batch sizes jump -> more evictions, kvcache_miss_rate doubled for some replicas. suspect batching policy + new kernel interplay. attaching logs: /var/logs/eval/abc1234/kvcache.log
jordan: safety examples: classifier score shift ~+0.07 on borderline prompts after tokenizer whitespace normalization. low severity unless safety pipeline downstream changes.
sasha: plan: 1) replicate locally with exact env (maya+oliver) 2) run playback with FP16 to confirm quant delta (oliver) 3) check autoscaling/batching config for that window (tony) 4) snapshot tokenizer and revert locally to compare (jordan) 5) if repro consistent, roll back int4 rollout for canary and re-run nightlies. owners acknowledged?
maya: acknowledged :thumbsup: will post repro checklist and a minimal repro repo link.
oliver: acknowledged. will run quantized kernel toggle matrix: int8/int4/fp16 on same seed.
tony: acknowledged. adding perf graphs to the thread and checking infra autoscaler logs.
jordan: acknowledged. will produce safety diff report and possible mitigation (restore tokenizer whitespace rules).
sasha: thanks — set a checkpoint at +2h. if any owner sees >10% user cohort impact escalate and ping #eng-oncall. keeping thread open for quick updates.
